title: Two Sum

-30 <= nums[i] <= 30
Every prefix and suffix product fits in a 32-bit integer.
hints: answer[i] = (product of everything left of i) * (product of everything right of i).

reference:
class Solution:
    def productExceptSelf(self, nums):
        n = len(nums); out = [1] * n; p = 1
        for i in range(n): out[i] = p; p *= nums[i]
        p = 1
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1): out[i] *= p; p *= nums[i]
        return out
